# German POS dictionary source

- Official repository: https://github.com/languagetool-org/german-pos-dict
- Commit: `a0d7adc94c13c0532e087b839159452663f7ea93`
- Archive URL: https://github.com/languagetool-org/german-pos-dict/archive/a0d7adc94c13c0532e087b839159452663f7ea93.tar.gz
- Format and use: Morfologik binary dictionaries for German word-form/POS lookup. `forms.tsv.gz` is a derived, ignored export generated by `scripts/export_german_morphology.sh` using Morfologik 2.1.6; it is UTF-8 TSV with no header and exactly three columns: surface, lemma, and tag.
